title: Accessibility platform (ARIA, screen readers, focus)
purpose: Provide the shared, non-visual UI substrate: semantic markup, correct ARIA, live regions, focus management, large targets and screen-reader parity.
architecturalScope: Accessibility bounded context, cross-cutting. Wraps the UI layer; consumed by all user-facing features.
domainContext: No domain state of its own; defines interaction contracts (speech-only, haptics, minimal interaction).

milestones.title: Accessible app shell
milestones.description: Semantic structure, landmarks, live regions, focus management.

milestones.title: Automated accessibility gates
milestones.description: axe-core/pa11y run in CI on core flows.

tasks.title: Define accessibility requirements and DoD (WCAG 2.2 AA)
acceptanceCriteria: ACCESSIBILITY.md exists and is referenced by the DoD.

tasks.title: Implement accessible app shell and ARIA live regions
acceptanceCriteria: Core flow operable with TalkBack without sight.

tasks.title: Integrate axe-core/pa11y into CI
acceptanceCriteria: CI fails on critical accessibility violations.
Every user-facing feature works without visual dependency (AGENTS.md 21).
No important information exists only visually.

risks.description: Visual information creeps in over time.
risks.mitigation: Automated gates plus regular sightless manual testing.

safetyImplications: None directly; accessibility failure can indirectly cause unsafe use and is treated as high severity.
accessibilityImplications: This track IS the accessibility foundation.
